/* MyDay 6.0 — navegación móvil amplia y equilibrada */ @media(max-width:759px){ #nv{height:auto;min-height:112px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,1fr);align-content:center;justify-content:stretch;gap:3px 5px;padding:7px 10px calc(8px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--a) 13%,var(--l));box-shadow:0 -10px 32px -25px rgba(10,22,55,.38);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 94%,transparent)} #nv .nav-links{display:contents} #nv button{width:100%;height:47px;min-width:0;flex:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:2px;padding:3px 2px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px} #nv .nav-icon{height:22px;width:24px;display:grid;place-items:center} #nv .nav-icon svg{width:19px;height:19px} #nv .nav-label{font-size:10px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:0;white-space:nowrap} #nv button.on{background:var(--as);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--a) 15%,transparent);color:var(--a)} #nv button:last-of-type{grid-column:4} main{padding-bottom:calc(160px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))} .quick-fab{bottom:calc(132px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))} } @media(max-width:380px){ #nv{min-height:108px;padding-left:7px;padding-right:7px;gap:2px 3px} #nv button{height:45px} #nv .nav-label{font-size:9px} main{padding-bottom:calc(154px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))} .quick-fab{bottom:calc(126px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))} } /* MyDay Intelligence 6.0 — lectura, contexto y conversación */ .intel-chat-card{border-radius:25px} .intel-chat-card .intel-chat-messages{min-height:280px;max-height:min(54vh,560px);padding:18px;gap:14px} .intel-chat-msg{max-width:min(94%,760px)} .intel-chat-bubble{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:6px 16px 16px} .intel-chat-msg.user .intel-chat-bubble{border-radius:16px 6px 16px 16px} .intel-chat-event{padding:10px 11px;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--l) 70%,transparent);background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 78%,var(--c))} .intel-chat-event b{font-size:11px}.intel-chat-event small{font-size:10px;line-height:1.5} .intel-chat-form{padding:15px 17px;align-items:center} .intel-chat-form input{min-height:46px;font-size:14px;padding:12px 15px} .intel-chat-form button{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;box-shadow:0 5px 15px -8px var(--a)} .intel-chat-suggestions button{font-size:11px;padding:8px 12px;transition:background .16s,border-color .16s} .intel-chat-suggestions button:hover{background:var(--as);border-color:var(--a)} @media(min-width:760px){.intel-page{max-width:940px;margin:0 auto}.intel-chat-card .intel-chat-messages{min-height:330px}}
